Topics. listing / keyword discovery using Helium 10 Magnet and Cerebro, optimizing titles for ranking, bullet point structuring, A+ content, main image contrast against competitors, UPC and FN SKU barcodes. ads / Sponsored Products structure, automatic campaigns (close match, loose match, substitutes, complements), keyword targeting (broad, phrase, exact), product targeting (competitor ASINs), negative keywords. ops / FBA vs FBM tradeoffs, calculating referral and pick/pack fees, storage fee calculation by cubic foot, FBA shipment creation, avoiding long-term storage fees. strategy / Brand Registry benefits, trademark acquisition (design vs word mark), category selection, brand referral bonus.
Look for.
Helium 10 filtering thresholds: max search volume < 5,000, minimum word count of 2, minimum keyword sales of 2.
Product pricing sweet spot: $15 to $85.
Target margin structure: 33% product cost, 33% Amazon FBA/referral fees, 33% profit.
PPC bidding mechanics: Setting dynamic bids (up and down) for automatic campaigns; using negative keywords for irrelevant broad matches.
FBA storage fee formula: $0.75 per cubic foot (Jan-Sep) and $2.40 (Oct-Dec). Long-term storage triggers at 365 days.
FBA shipment setup: Box max dimensions (25 inches any side), max weight (50 lbs).
Brand referral bonus: Drives referral fee down from 15% to 5% for external traffic.
Skip.
Retail arbitrage (Costco scanning) and online arbitrage (Big Lots).
Review manipulation (paying friends via Venmo/PayPal to buy and review).
"Get rich quick" dropshipping mentalities and repetitive course pitches.
Scope mix. Mostly growth. Baseline: Brand Registry active, FBA utilized for Prime eligibility, FN SKU labeled, no suppressed listings.
Volume. High. Extractable mechanics cover 12 hours of content, though repetitive success stories heavily pad the runtime.
